asset.name: Welcome to the team
asset.description: Sent to the new hire's personal email once the manager has prepared the first week.
asset.subject: Welcome, {{new_hire_name}}: your first day on {{=FORMAT_DATE(start_date, "DD/MM/YYYY")}}
asset.html_body:
Welcome to the team

Hi {{new_hire_name}},

We are looking forward to you joining us as {{job_title}} on {{=FORMAT_DATE(start_date, "DD/MM/YYYY")}}. Your manager is {{manager_name}}.

  • Your work email will be {{work_email}} (employee number {{employee_number}}).
  • Your buddy for the first weeks: {{task_data.buddy}}.
  • Equipment: {{onboarding_kit.laptop_model}} ({{=IF(CONTAINS(location, "remote"), "shipped to your home address before day one", "waiting at your desk")}}).

Your first week

{{task_data.first_week_plan}}

{{=IF(orientation_needed, "You are booked onto company orientation in your first week.", "")}}

Sent by your employee onboarding workflow
